title: Instance (base class)
summary: The ancestor of every object in Roblox: Parts, Players, GUIs, everything. Owns the universal API — Name, Parent, FindFirstChild, WaitForChild, GetChildren, Clone, Destroy, IsA, attributes, and the Changed/AncestryChanged events.

methods.name: Instance.new
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the given class. Set properties BEFORE parenting for best performance.

methods.name: FindFirstChild
methods.description: Immediate child by name, or nil. Non-yielding — the safe nil-checkable lookup.

methods.name: WaitForChild
methods.description: Yields until the child exists (or timeout → returns nil with a warning). The standard fix for replication timing.

methods.name: FindFirstChildOfClass / FindFirstChildWhichIsA
methods.description: First child of exact class / of that class or subclasses.

methods.name: IsA / IsDescendantOf
methods.description: Class check including inheritance: part:IsA("BasePart") is true for Parts, MeshParts, etc.

methods.name: Clone / Destroy
methods.description: Clone returns an unparented deep copy. Destroy permanently breaks the instance (Parent locked nil, Changed fires).

methods.name: GetAttribute / SetAttribute / GetAttributes
methods.description: Custom named data on any instance — replicates to clients, survives streaming, visible in Studio.

methods.name: GetPropertyChangedSignal
methods.description: Event that fires when one specific property changes.

events.name: Changed
events.description: Fires when ANY property changes, passing the property name. For physics-heavy properties this fires very often.

events.name: AncestryChanged
events.description: Fires when the instance's ancestry (its own or descendants') changes — parented, unparented, destroyed.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: The object's name (not necessarily unique among siblings).

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Where the object lives in the hierarchy. nil = not in any tree (and Destroyed objects are locked to nil).

properties.name: ClassName
properties.description: The exact class name as a string.

properties.name: Archivable
properties.description: Whether Clone() copies this instance (and children).

explanation.whatItIs: Every object in Roblox is an Instance of some class — and every one of them inherits this shared toolbox: naming, parenting, searching the tree, cloning, destroying, tagging with attributes, and listening for changes.
explanation.whyItExists: One consistent object model means one set of skills works everywhere: the way you find a Part is the way you find a GUI is the way you find a Player.
whenToUse: Instance.new to build objects at runtime (set properties BEFORE parenting)
FindFirstChild for safe lookups; WaitForChild when replication timing is the issue
GetDescendants to scan a whole subtree
Attributes for lightweight per-object data that replicates
whenNotToUse: Indexing children directly with `parent.ChildName` when the child might not exist — nil-index crash risk; prefer FindFirstChild
WaitForChild in hot loops or with huge timeouts — it yields your thread
explanation.mentalModel:
```text
Instance (base)
  ├─ BasePart → Part, MeshPart, WedgePart…
  ├─ Model → Player characters, Spawns…
  ├─ GuiObject → Frame, TextLabel, TextButton…
  └─ …hundreds more

Every one of them has: Name, Parent, FindFirstChild,
WaitForChild, Clone, Destroy, IsA, attributes, Changed.
```
tips: Create → configure → parent LAST: `local p = Instance.new("Part"); p.Size = ...; p.Parent = workspace`
Destroyed instances are zombies: keep no references; Parent is locked nil forever
Use IsA over ClassName comparisons — it respects inheritance
Attributes + CollectionService tags = flexible per-object data + grouping
commonMistakes: `workspace.SomePart` style indexing when SomePart might be missing → 'attempt to index nil'
Forgetting Destroy() doesn't run immediately-garbage-collection-wise — drop your references too
Clone() returns an UNPARENTED copy — you must set Parent to see it
Listening to Changed for a property and getting flooded (e.g., Position) — use GetPropertyChangedSignal or throttle

examples.title: The safe-lookup trifecta
examples.code:
-- 1) Might not exist? FindFirstChild
local coin = workspace:FindFirstChild("Coin")
if coin then
    coin:Destroy()
end

-- 2) Should exist soon (replication)? WaitForChild
local remotes = game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes", 5)
if not remotes then
    warn("Remotes never replicated!")
end

-- 3) Need a specific class? FindFirstChildOfClass
local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

-- 4) Is it the right kind of thing?
if coin and coin:IsA("BasePart") then
    print("Coin is a part")
end

examples.title: Runtime creation done right
examples.code:
local part = Instance.new("Part")
part.Name = "SpawnPad"
part.Size = Vector3.new(6, 1, 6)
part.Anchored = true
part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 200, 255)
part.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, 0.5, 0)
part.Parent = workspace      -- parent LAST: one replication event

part:SetAttribute("Interactive", true)
print(part:GetAttribute("Interactive"))   --> true
